fills.tieReason: The frames never show the number. In every frame where the Reinforced Keel tooltip is visible (s_02976 to s_02987), the webcam covers everything below the cost line. Visible text is 'REINFORCED KEEL / Naval Technology 1/2 / 100 / Unique to Vikings', and the OCR found no description text either. The value comes from the streamer reading the tooltip aloud. The whisper transcript (data/upcoming-civs/transcripts/nd74LibluQ0.whisper.txt, 49:32-49:39) has 'this increases ship health by 25 percent and ranged armor by one'. That is spoken at the moment the tooltip appears (frame 2976 = 49:36), right after he read the Naval Arrowslits tooltip. So 25 means +25% ship health, with +1 ranged armor as a second effect, for tier 1 of 2. It should be tagged as narration-sourced, not read from pixels.
